thread:
Alex R.: Quick sync — finishing the postmortem for INC-834. We have 5 open action items. Need confirmed owners and solid ETAs by EOD tomorrow so I can close the tracker. If something blocks you, call it out now.

Maya P.: I can take action 1 (deploy gating tests + flake cleanup). ETA: Wed 2026-03-25. Depends on eng-infra PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 — will add a note in the PR about required rollback test. :white_check_mark:

Samir K.: I'll own action 2 (alert thresholds and pager tuning). ETA: Mon 2026-03-23. Quick heads up — will need a brief review from oncall (2-3m) before we apply.

Jordan T.: I can pick up action 3 (dashboard + runbook links). Blocking: need telemetry hook (event schema) from telemetry team. @Priya S., any ETA on that hook?

Priya S.: Telemetry hook for INC-834 is on the infra sprint, should be merged by Fri 2026-03-20 EOD. If you need a stopgap, I can expose sampled metrics to start.

Jordan T.: Ok that'll work — I'll build dashboard with sampled metrics and annotate the runbook to switch to full metrics once the hook lands. ETA: Thu 2026-03-26.

oncall-bot: Attached runbook snapshot: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inc-834-canary-playbook — version 3.1. (automated attach)

Alex R.: Thanks. Action 4 is the canary rollback playbook ownership (ensure steps + contact list). I need an oncall signoff and a short tabletop run. Who can do the signoff?

Samir K.: I can coordinate the tabletop and collect signoffs. Propose a 30m slot Thu 3/19 10:00 PT — does that work for oncall / eng-sre?

Priya S.: Thu 3/19 10:00 PT works for eng-sre. I'll attend and sign off if the playbook includes the telemetry cutoff and alert rollback steps.

Maya P.: I'll add a short checklist to the runbook for deploy owners (how to validate KV cache and sequence).

Alex R.: Action 5 is dependent tasks (customer-facing docs + PR templates). Who's best? Jordan or Maya?

Jordan T.: I can draft the doc and PR template, but will need a quick review from Docs. ETA: Mon 3/23 (draft), Tue 3/24 (reviewed).

Alex R.: Great. Two process items: 1) Please update the action tracker (spreadsheet link below) with owner + ETA and mark any external deps. 2) If you cannot meet ETA, reply in this thread with the blocker and proposed new date. I'll publish the final owner list at 12:00 PT tomorrow.

Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-Incident-Actions-Tracker

Samir K.: I'll update the tracker now. Also tagging @oncall-bot for automated reminder 24h before owner's ETA.

oncall-bot: Reminder rule set — will post 24h before each owner's ETA.

Maya P.: small note — PR #2345 includes a change that may temporarily increase test runtime by ~20s. I'll document it in the PR so deploy cadence teams know.

Alex R.: Perfect. If no objections, consider items 1–5 claimed as above. If anything changes, flag here. Thanks all.

Jordan T.: ACK, will update tracker and ping docs for review.

Priya S.: ACK, adding telemetry ETA to the tracker.

Maya P.: ACK, will add PR notes and update checklist.

Samir K.: ACK — tabletop invite sent.

Alex R.: Closing note — I'll post the final owners list and the consolidated due dates into the incident channel by 12:00 PT tomorrow. If you need to reassign before then ping me directly. :thumbsup:
